Built a complete, responsive dinosaur battler in `index.html`. Choose attacks, guards, or heals; switch between your three dinosaurs; and battle through three increasingly tough opponents. The game includes custom SVG dinosaur art, turn-based enemy AI, health and shield tracking, action history, victory/defeat screens, reset, and optional sound effects.

Verified the game in a browser at mobile size and tested battle actions. Assumption: battles start immediately with the Triceratops and progress through three waves.
